schema: CREATE TABLE facts(key TEXT NOT NULL,value DOUBLE PRECISION,qkind TEXT,unit TEXT,period TEXT,support TEXT,source TEXT)
CREATE TABLE history(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY)

stages.name: baseline
views: CREATE VIEW source_0 AS SELECT f.value,f.qkind,f.unit,f.period,f.support,'ok' AS status FROM (SELECT key,value,qkind,unit,period,support,source FROM facts WHERE present(provenance())) f WHERE f.key='area|forest'

CREATE VIEW source_1 AS SELECT f.value,f.qkind,f.unit,f.period,f.support,'ok' AS status FROM (SELECT key,value,qkind,unit,period,support,source FROM facts WHERE present(provenance())) f WHERE f.key='area|pasture'

CREATE VIEW source_2 AS SELECT f.value,f.qkind,f.unit,f.period,f.support,'ok' AS status FROM (SELECT key,value,qkind,unit,period,support,source FROM facts WHERE present(provenance())) f WHERE f.key='soil|forest'

CREATE VIEW source_3 AS SELECT f.value,f.qkind,f.unit,f.period,f.support,'ok' AS status FROM (SELECT key,value,qkind,unit,period,support,source FROM facts WHERE present(provenance())) f WHERE f.key='soil|pasture'

CREATE VIEW output_0 AS SELECT CASE WHEN status IN ('ok','contextual') THEN computed ELSE NULL END AS value,'stock' AS qkind,'t C' AS unit,'instant:2021' AS period,'municipality_class' AS support,status FROM (SELECT (i0.value * i1.value * 1) AS computed,CASE WHEN i0.status='orphan' OR i1.status='orphan' THEN 'orphan' WHEN i0.status='unresolved' OR i1.status='unresolved' THEN 'unresolved' WHEN i0.status='blocked' OR i1.status='blocked' THEN 'blocked' WHEN (i0.qkind<>'stock') OR (replace(i0.unit,'/ a','/ yr')<>replace('t C/ha','/ a','/ yr')) OR (i0.period<>'instant:2021') OR (i0.support<>'municipality_class') OR (i1.qkind<>'area') OR (replace(i1.unit,'/ a','/ yr')<>replace('ha','/ a','/ yr')) OR (i1.period<>'instant:2021') OR (i1.support<>'municipality_class') THEN 'blocked' WHEN i0.status='contextual' OR i1.status='contextual' THEN 'contextual' ELSE 'ok' END AS status FROM (SELECT 1 AS seed) seed CROSS JOIN source_2 i0 CROSS JOIN source_0 i1) calculation

CREATE VIEW output_1 AS SELECT CASE WHEN status IN ('ok','contextual') THEN computed ELSE NULL END AS value,'stock' AS qkind,'t C' AS unit,'instant:2021' AS period,'municipality_class' AS support,status FROM (SELECT (i0.value * i1.value * 1) AS computed,CASE WHEN i0.status='orphan' OR i1.status='orphan' THEN 'orphan' WHEN i0.status='unresolved' OR i1.status='unresolved' THEN 'unresolved' WHEN i0.status='blocked' OR i1.status='blocked' THEN 'blocked' WHEN (i0.qkind<>'stock') OR (replace(i0.unit,'/ a','/ yr')<>replace('t C/ha','/ a','/ yr')) OR (i0.period<>'instant:2021') OR (i0.support<>'municipality_class') OR (i1.qkind<>'area') OR (replace(i1.unit,'/ a','/ yr')<>replace('ha','/ a','/ yr')) OR (i1.period<>'instant:2021') OR (i1.support<>'municipality_class') THEN 'blocked' WHEN i0.status='contextual' OR i1.status='contextual' THEN 'contextual' ELSE 'ok' END AS status FROM (SELECT 1 AS seed) seed CROSS JOIN source_3 i0 CROSS JOIN source_1 i1) calculation

CREATE VIEW output_2 AS SELECT CASE WHEN status IN ('ok','contextual') THEN computed ELSE NULL END AS value,'stock' AS qkind,'t C' AS unit,'instant:2021' AS period,'municipality' AS support,status FROM (SELECT (i0.value + i1.value) AS computed,CASE WHEN i0.status='orphan' OR i1.status='orphan' THEN 'orphan' WHEN i0.status='unresolved' OR i1.status='unresolved' THEN 'unresolved' WHEN i0.status='blocked' OR i1.status='blocked' THEN 'blocked' WHEN (i1.qkind<>i0.qkind) OR (replace(i1.unit,'/ a','/ yr')<>replace(i0.unit,'/ a','/ yr')) OR (i1.period<>i0.period) THEN 'blocked' WHEN i0.status='contextual' OR i1.status='contextual' THEN 'contextual' ELSE 'ok' END AS status FROM (SELECT 1 AS seed) seed CROSS JOIN output_0 i0 CROSS JOIN output_1 i1) calculation
